readability.status: Both actual complete blinded LLM submissions validated and aggregated; not a human study
readability.method: Both review all60 complete available X/Y pairs independently, no source/gold/tool labels/private mapping access; frozen six-dimension rubric
limitations: Only readability/task comprehension; not behavioral correctness or usable-coverage proof.
Repeated target/compiler/optimization/symbol variants are correlated; not 60 independent programs.
LLM reviewer bias and shared model lineage; no human or population-level generalization.
Engine style can imperfectly unblind X/Y; reviewers disclose suspected style inference.
No text-length score, no performance ranking, no universal parity claim.

performance.status: Not measured as normalized performance; no idle-host or comparative-speed claim

Repeated configurations are correlated; no population inference or universal parity claim.
